10. Economics: this implementation does not earn the advantage
A competent ordinary comparator

I used an introduced sixteen-vessel automated-synthesis comparison, with one robot, common utilities, capping where useful, purification, structural analysis and the same optical assay.

At 8% real discount over ten years, 1,500 billable instrument-hours annually, $40/hour labor and $80/MWh electricity:

Introduced comparator	Turnaround	Cost per library	30% reduction target
Favorable parallel-synthesis case	7.15 h	$347.36	$243.15
Slower parallel-synthesis case	13.67 h	$686.49	$480.54

These are engineering scenarios, not matched quotations or proof that a six-minute assay authenticates this exact library.

They are nevertheless credible adversarial comparisons: automated solid-phase synthesis already reaches long non-natural oligomers, including a reported 42-mer recognition-encoded melamine oligomer. 
pubs.rsc.org

The proposed favorable schedule takes 16.78 hours. It therefore does not approach a threefold turnaround improvement.

Molecular stock dominates

At 2 nmol initiator per program:

Total initial sites: 32 nmol.
Twenty positions × three fresh matching-site attempts: 1.920 µmol packet stock per cycle.
Twenty 50-nucleotide program strands per site: 640 nmol strands, approximately 10.56 mg DNA.
Even an optimistic 25-nucleotide packet precursor adds approximately 15.84 mg DNA.

The complete proposed adaptor requires more domains than that optimistic precursor, so the stock screen understates the complete construction.

Public procurement data distinguish ordered synthesis scale from delivered purified quantity. They also explicitly do not guarantee yield for most modified oligonucleotides. A purchased synthesis scale cannot be treated as fully functional conjugate stock. 
eurofinsgenomics.com
+1

Using the actual specified sequences gives 43 position/block packet types in each library and 49 across the four libraries.
